organization.description:
Open Healthsite Consulting operates healthsites.io, a Digital Public Good. Through the Global Healthsites Mapping Project, we are building an open map of every health facility worldwide with the OpenStreetMap community, making accurate location data freely available to all.

https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Global_Healthsites_Mapping_Project
https://github.com/healthsites/healthsites/wiki/API
